metadata.description: Claude skills for nine sports data APIs: hockey, football, basketball, baseball, soccer, tennis, golf, UFC and cricket.

plugins.name: sports-analytics-core
plugins.description: Sport-agnostic skills: model building, feature engineering, backtesting, walk-forward validation, calibration, Elo, visualization, data pipelines, and comparing a model with the market as information.

plugins.name: nhl-data
plugins.description: Hockey analysis skills on PuckAPI: game previews, player and team research, and the community's standard metrics, with every number pulled live from the PuckAPI MCP server.
